e_ErrModelSDKMismatch The model is incompatible with the current SDK version. e_ErrNoTable There are no tables in the PDF document. e_ErrOCRFailure OCR recognition failed. e_ErrOutOfMemory api/PDFSolid_Conversion.Common.html.title: Namespace PDFSolid_Conversion.Common | PDFSolid Conversion SDK
api/PDFSolid_Conversion.Common.html.summary: Namespace PDFSolid_Conversion.Common Classes DetectionResult Detection result. ExcelOptions PDF to Excel conversion parameter object. HtmlOptions PDF to Html conversion parameter object. ImageOptions PDF to Image conversion parameter object. JsonOptions PDF to Json conversion parameter object. LibraryManager Manages all operations related to the SDK library. The LibraryManager class serves as a central hub for managing the lifecycle of an SDK library. It provides functionalities such as initializing the library with specified resources, verifying licenses, installing fonts, setting up logging and progress callbacks, retrieving version information, and counting pages in documents. MarkdownOptions PDF to Markdown conversion parameter object. OCRResult OCR recognition result. OfdOptions PDF to Ofd conversion parameter object. PptOptions PDF to Powerpoint conversion parameter object. RtfOptions PDF to Rtf conversion parameter object. SearchablePdfOptions PDF to PDF conversion parameter object. TableRecResult Table recognition result. TxtOptions PDF to Txt conversion parameter object. WordOptions PDF to Word conversion parameter object. Structs ConvertCallback Contains handle and delegates for conversion callbacks. Enums ErrorCode Enumeration for error code. ExcelWorksheetOption Excel Worksheet option. HtmlPageOption Html page option. ImageColorMode Image Color Mode. ImageType Image type. OCRLanguage OCR Language. OCROption OCR option. PageLayoutMode Page Layout Mode. Delegates OnCancel The delegate for the LibraryManager object, called to determine whether a conversion operation should be canceled. OnGetLayoutResult The delegate for retrieving layout analysis result as a UTF-8 JSON string. The returned pointer must remain valid until the next call to this callback. OnGetOCRResult The delegate for retrieving OCR result as a UTF-8 JSON string. The returned pointer must remain valid until the next call to this callback. OnGetTableResult The delegate for retrieving table recognition result as a UTF-8 JSON string. The returned pointer must remain valid until the next call to this callback. OnLayout The delegate for external layout analysis on a temporary image file. OnOCR The delegate for external OCR recognition on a temporary image file. OnProgress The delegate for the LibraryManager object,called when a conversion operation finishes working on a page in a document. OnTable The delegate for external table recognition on a temporary image file.
